# libmseed 2.19.8 placeholder

Run `../fetch-libmseed-2.19.8.sh` (from this directory) or simply run `make`
from the ITSV project root. The build will fetch the exact unmodified upstream
libmseed 2.19.8 source archive, verify its SHA-256 checksum, and populate this
directory before building `libmseed.a`.

Source archive: Debian's `libmseed_2.19.8.orig.tar.gz`, which is the unmodified
upstream 2.19.8 source release.

Expected SHA-256:
`29080c80ef0bf9dd97056ca20079ad8db75e2d0f283e187ff45065337d3abe05`

The fetched libmseed source retains its own upstream license and copyright
notices and is not covered by ITSV's MIT license.
